metadata.title: JGTD Dubai 2026 | Uniglo Diamonds Stand SJ23
metadata.description: Meet Uniglo Diamonds at Stand SJ23 during JGTD Dubai 2026, 27–29 October at Expo City. Discuss natural-diamond sourcing and book a meeting.

hero.title: JGTD Dubai 2026 – Meet Uniglo Diamonds at Stand SJ23
hero.lead: JGTD Dubai 2026 – Meet Uniglo Diamonds at Stand SJ23
hero.para1: JGTD Dubai 2026, formally Jewellery, Gem & Technology in Dubai 2026, will take place from 27–29 October at Dubai Exhibition Centre in Expo City Dubai. The international trade exhibition will be open daily from 10:00 to 18:00 in North Halls N21 and N23.
hero.para2: Meet Uniglo Diamonds at Stand SJ23 to discuss natural diamonds for retail, wholesale, bridal, bespoke and jewellery-manufacturing requirements. Buyers can explore individual centre stones, matched pairs, calibrated selections and repeat requirements based on specific shapes, measurements, colour and clarity combinations.
hero.para3: Professional visitors can book an appointment before the show and provide their sourcing brief in advance, allowing the Uniglo Diamonds team to prepare a more focused commercial discussion.
hero.primaryCta: Book a Meeting at Stand SJ23
hero.imageAlt: Uniglo Diamonds at JGTD Dubai 2026 stand SJ23

whatIs.title: JGTD Dubai 2026 Dates and Venue
whatIs.para1: JGTD will run from Tuesday 27 October through Thursday 29 October 2026. The exhibition is open from 10:00 to 18:00 on all three days.
whatIs.para2: The 2026 event will be held in North Halls N21 and N23 of Dubai Exhibition Centre at Expo City Dubai. This is not the Dubai World Trade Centre on Sheikh Zayed Road, so visitors should check their transport and accommodation plans carefully.
whatIs.para3: Registration counters close 30 minutes before the show ends. Buyers with several supplier appointments should allow additional time for badge collection, security and movement between exhibition sectors.
whatIs.whatIsTitle: What Is Jewellery, Gem & Technology in Dubai?
whatIs.whatIsPara1: Jewellery, Gem & Technology in Dubai is an international B2B exhibition connecting jewellery suppliers with professional buyers from the Middle East and other global markets.
whatIs.whatIsPara2: JGTD is intended for sourcing, supplier evaluation, commercial meetings and business development. It is not a consumer jewellery-shopping event.
whatIs.areasLabel: The exhibition combines several parts of the jewellery supply chain within one commercial environment:
whatIs.imageAlt: JGTD Dubai 2026 exhibition at Dubai Exhibition Centre

whyMatters.title: Why JGTD Matters to International Diamond Buyers
whyMatters.para1: Dubai provides an important meeting point for diamond and jewellery businesses serving regional and international markets. JGTD gives these businesses three focused days to compare products, evaluate suppliers and discuss commercial requirements in person.
whyMatters.para2: A retailer may use the show to identify diamonds for a bridal assortment. A manufacturer may need calibrated stones compatible with an established design. A wholesaler may be sourcing commercially relevant specifications for customers across several markets.
whyMatters.para3: Physical viewing also allows buyers to compare outlines, face-up appearance and overall visual characteristics before deciding whether a diamond suits its intended application.
whyMatters.considerLabel: An in-person discussion can address factors that are difficult to resolve through inventory listings alone:

meet.title: Meet Uniglo Diamonds at JGTD Dubai 2026
meet.para1: The official exhibitor information lists Uniglo NV of Belgium at Stand SJ23.
meet.para2: Professional buyers can meet the Uniglo Diamonds team to discuss natural diamonds across different shapes, weights, measurements, colours and clarities. Requirements may involve one individual diamond, matched stones, calibrated selections or repeat supply for an established jewellery design.
meet.para3: Buyers should submit their most important specifications before the exhibition whenever possible.
meetingItems: Diamonds for tennis bracelets and necklaces
meet.cta: Book a JGTD Meeting at Stand SJ23

whatCanSource.title: What Diamond Buyers Can Source at JGTD Dubai
whatCanSource.para1: JGTD presents loose diamonds alongside coloured gemstones, pearls, finished jewellery, mountings, components and manufacturing technology.
whatCanSource.para2: Diamond buyers may encounter products ranging from individual documented stones to matched pairs, layouts and commercial selections. However, availability and specifications will differ between exhibitors.
whatCanSource.para3: At Uniglo Diamonds, the discussion focuses on natural diamonds selected around the buyer's intended product, market and commercial requirements.

naturalDiamondSourcing.title: Natural Diamond Sourcing in Dubai
naturalDiamondSourcing.para1: A successful sourcing decision begins with the purpose of the diamond, not only the grades recorded on a report.
naturalDiamondSourcing.para2: A centre stone for a solitaire ring may be assessed differently from diamonds required for earrings, an eternity band or a tennis bracelet. Measurements, proportions, matching, visual appearance, documentation and repeat availability can all affect commercial suitability.
naturalDiamondSourcing.para3: Availability changes, so the meeting should begin with both preferred specifications and acceptable alternatives. This allows the team to determine where suitable sourcing possibilities may exist.
naturalDiamondSourcing.imageAlt: Natural diamonds presented by Uniglo Diamonds at JGTD Dubai

retailersManufacturers.title: Natural Diamonds for Retailers and Manufacturers
retailersManufacturers.para1: Retailers, manufacturers and wholesalers frequently approach sourcing with different priorities.
retailersManufacturers.para2: A retailer may require a distinctive centre stone for an individual customer or a selection of commercially recognisable options for a bridal range. A manufacturer may require repeat supply within defined measurements and production tolerances. A wholesaler may be building assortments for several customer groups and price positions.
retailersManufacturers.para3: Connecting these specifications to the intended jewellery helps ensure that the diamonds are evaluated in the correct context.

shapes.title: Diamond Shapes for Different Markets
shapes.para1: Diamond-shape demand can vary between countries, retailers, customers and jewellery categories.
shapes.para2: Round Brilliant diamonds remain important for engagement rings, earrings, tennis jewellery and classic designs. Oval, Pear and Marquise diamonds offer elongated outlines and a different visual spread.
shapes.para3: Emerald and Asscher cuts provide step-cut faceting and broader flashes of light. Cushion and Radiant diamonds combine distinctive outlines with lively brilliance, while Princess-cut diamonds may suit square and geometric designs. Heart-shaped diamonds can support romantic and highly personalised jewellery.
shapes.para4: No shape is automatically suitable for every market. Buyers should consider the intended setting, customer, price position and collection identity before making a decision.

measurements.title: Measurements, Proportions and Face-Up Appearance
measurements.para1: Two diamonds with the same carat weight can have noticeably different measurements, proportions and face-up appearances.
measurements.para2: These differences are particularly relevant for fancy-shaped diamonds. Length-to-width ratio, outline and weight distribution can influence how an Oval, Pear, Emerald, Cushion or Radiant diamond looks when set.
measurements.para3: A manufacturer may require precise dimensions for an existing mounting. A retailer may prefer a defined ratio or face-up size. A designer may need proportions that support a specific creative direction.
measurements.para4: Clear measurement requirements make the discussion more efficient and reduce unsuitable options.
measurements.considerLabel: Buyers should identify whether they require:
considerItems: Visual characteristics beyond the grading report

matching.title: Matched and Calibrated Natural Diamonds
matching.para1: Matched and calibrated diamonds are especially important when several stones will be used together.
matching.para2: Diamond earrings, three-stone rings, eternity bands, tennis bracelets, tennis necklaces and other multi-stone jewellery may require coordination across measurements, shape, colour, clarity and visual appearance.
matching.para3: For manufacturers, consistency can also affect setting efficiency and production repeatability. Significant variations may require adjustments during setting and can produce an uneven finished result.
matching.para4: The intended design, setting method and production quantity should be explained at the beginning of the sourcing process.
matching.imageAlt: Matched and calibrated natural diamonds from Uniglo Diamonds

bridal.title: Natural Diamonds for Bridal Jewellery
bridal.para1: Bridal jewellery remains one of the most important uses of polished natural diamonds.
bridal.para2: Retailers may require documented centre stones covering several shapes, weights and price positions. Manufacturers may need centre diamonds and matched side stones for repeatable engagement-ring designs. Bespoke jewellers may require one particular diamond selected around an individual client.
bridal.para3: A useful bridal assortment can combine established core options with selected fancy-shaped diamonds for customers seeking something more individual.

certification.title: Certification and Documentation Requirements
certification.para1: Documentation requirements depend on the diamond's size, value, intended market, application and customer expectations.
certification.para2: Some buyers require individual grading reports for centre stones. Other applications may use commercial documentation appropriate to smaller or calibrated diamonds. Import, export, insurance and inventory procedures may create further requirements.
certification.para3: Documentation should be discussed before a final selection is prepared.
considerItems: Whether individual grading reports are required
Requirements for parcels, pairs or layouts

antwerp.title: Antwerp Diamond Expertise for Dubai's International Market
antwerp.para1: JGTD connects international diamond suppliers with businesses serving Dubai, the wider Middle East and other global jewellery markets.
antwerp.para2: Uniglo Diamonds brings an Antwerp-based sourcing background to this commercial environment. The team begins by understanding what the buyer plans to manufacture, stock or sell before discussing potentially suitable specifications.
antwerp.para3: A productive supply relationship depends on clear communication, accurate specifications, suitable documentation and realistic expectations — not location alone.
supportItems: Bespoke jewellers sourcing for individual clients

prepare.title: Preparing for a Meeting at Stand SJ23
prepare.para: Buyers can make better use of the three-day exhibition by preparing a concise sourcing brief before arriving.
prepare.note: Buyers do not need to arrive with a completed order. A clear collection gap, production requirement or customer request can provide a productive starting point.
prepare.cta: Book a JGTD Meeting at Stand SJ23

diamondWeek.title: JGTD and Dubai Diamond Week 2026
diamondWeek.para1: JGTD is the commercial sourcing component of Dubai Diamond Week, which runs from 26–29 October 2026.
diamondWeek.para2: The Dubai Diamond Conference opens the week on 26 October, followed by industry meetings and activities. JGTD then runs from 27–29 October at Dubai Exhibition Centre, providing a marketplace for sourcing, supplier meetings and business development.
diamondWeek.para3: For diamond professionals, the combination creates opportunities to consider wider industry strategy and immediate commercial sourcing during the same trip.

registration.title: JGTD Dubai Registration and Admission
registration.para1: JGTD is a trade-only exhibition for jewellery-industry professionals aged 16 or above. Registration is mandatory, and admission is free.
registration.para2: Visitors who register online by 16 October 2026 can receive a home-print badge for faster entry. After 16 October, badges must be collected from the registration counters onsite.
registration.para3: Badge and identity details may be checked before entry. Visitors should review the organiser's current requirements before travelling.
requireItems: An Emirates ID or national passport

venue.title: Getting to Dubai Exhibition Centre
venue.para1: Dubai Exhibition Centre is located on Exhibition Boulevard at Expo City Dubai.
venue.metroPara: The organiser recommends the Dubai Metro as a convenient way to reach the venue. The Red Line serves Expo City Metro station, providing access to the Expo City area and Dubai Exhibition Centre.
venue.carPara: The venue can also be reached by car or taxi. Designated parking is located near the exhibition centre, and the organiser may operate connections between public parking areas and the venue. Drivers should follow current Expo City signage and event-day parking guidance.
venue.airportPara: Dubai Exhibition Centre is approximately 35 minutes from Dubai International Airport under suitable traffic conditions. Actual travel time will vary according to traffic, arrival terminal and transport method.
venue.newVenueTitle: Why the Expo City and North Halls Location Matters
venue.newVenuePara: JGTD 2026 will occupy North Halls N21 and N23 at Dubai Exhibition Centre. The Expo City location provides metro access and purpose-built exhibition facilities. Buyers can meet suppliers across diamonds, gemstones, finished jewellery and industry technology within one professional sourcing environment. Visitors should review the final floor plan before arriving and leave sufficient time to move between exhibition sectors and scheduled appointments.

items.question: When is JGTD Dubai 2026?
items.answer: JGTD Dubai 2026 takes place from Tuesday 27 October to Thursday 29 October 2026.

items.question: Where is JGTD Dubai 2026 being held?
items.answer: The show is being held in North Halls N21 and N23 of Dubai Exhibition Centre at Expo City Dubai.

items.question: What are the opening hours?
items.answer: JGTD is open from 10:00 to 18:00 on all three days. Registration counters close 30 minutes before the show ends.

items.question: Is JGTD being held at Dubai World Trade Centre?
items.answer: No. The confirmed venue is Dubai Exhibition Centre at Expo City Dubai, not Dubai World Trade Centre on Sheikh Zayed Road.

items.question: What is Uniglo Diamonds' stand number?
items.answer: Uniglo Diamonds will exhibit at Stand SJ23.

items.question: Is JGTD open to the public?
items.answer: No. JGTD is a trade-only exhibition for recognised jewellery-industry professionals.

items.question: Is there a minimum age?
items.answer: Yes. Visitors must be at least 16 years old.

items.question: Is registration free?
items.answer: Admission is free, but registration is mandatory. Register online by 16 October 2026 to receive a home-print badge; later badges must be collected onsite.

items.question: What documents should visitors bring?
items.answer: Visitors should bring a printed entrance badge and either an Emirates ID or national passport.

items.question: What products are exhibited at JGTD?
items.answer: The show covers diamonds, coloured gemstones, pearls, finished and semi-finished jewellery, mountings, tools, machinery, laboratory technology, displays and packaging.

items.question: What can buyers discuss with Uniglo Diamonds?
items.answer: Buyers can discuss natural diamonds based on shape, carat weight, measurements, colour, clarity, documentation, matching, quantities and intended jewellery application.

items.question: Can buyers discuss matched or calibrated diamonds?
items.answer: Yes. Buyers can discuss matched pairs, coordinated side stones, calibrated selections and layouts for multi-stone jewellery.

items.question: Can Uniglo Diamonds support bridal requirements?
items.answer: Buyers can discuss centre stones, side stones and calibrated diamonds for engagement rings, wedding bands, eternity rings and other bridal designs.

items.question: How can visitors reach JGTD by metro?
items.answer: Use the Dubai Metro Red Line to Expo City Metro station and follow current venue directions for Dubai Exhibition Centre.

items.question: Is JGTD part of Dubai Diamond Week?
items.answer: Yes. JGTD runs from 27–29 October as the commercial sourcing component of Dubai Diamond Week, which begins on 26 October.

items.question: Can buyers arrange a meeting before the show?
items.answer: Yes. Buyers should book in advance and submit their requirements so Uniglo Diamonds can prepare a relevant discussion.
